scores.evidence: The s1-lifecycle flowchart TD reads well at 390 px, with Japanese labels at a legible size (pages/mobile-jp-04.png, pages/mobile-jp-05.png). All tables (s3-table, s4-scopes, s5-checks, practice-b-model, practice-b-model-b) fit at 390 px without clipping (pages/mobile-jp-13.png, pages/mobile-jp-16.png, pages/mobile-jp-18.png, pages/mobile-jp-25.png). Long command strings in s2-settings and practice-model-settings line 9/18 soft-wrap in the middle of 'hooks' ('/.claude/hoo' then 'ks/block-rm.sh'), which still reads but looks awkward (pages/mobile-jp-09.png, pages/mobile-jp-23.png).

Every screen has a heading, figure, table, code block or check (textOnlyScreens empty), and paragraphs stay short. The exception is the practice-b-quiz prompt: it puts both scenarios A and B into one 10-line bold paragraph on mobile, which is hard to scan and compare (pages/mobile-jp-24.png, pages/desktop-jp-17.png).

The lesson is Japanese only. Diagram labels, captions, table headers and controls are all in Japanese, and no stray English UI text appears. Inline code chips stay whole and wrap to the next line cleanly (pages/mobile-jp-10.png, pages/mobile-jp-27.png). No controls are hidden under the top or bottom bars, and no personal data appears on any screen opened.

mustFix.issue: The q9 prompt packs the full descriptions of candidates A and B, plus the question, into one bold paragraph. At 390 px that is 10 dense bold lines. The learner has to hold both scenarios in mind to compare them, and nothing visually separates A from B.
mustFix.fix: Move the scenario out of the prompt into practice-b-task as a 2-item list or a small table (A: 社内チームの課題管理MCPサーバー…／B: 作者とソースがわかる「全部入り」プラグイン…). Then cut the q9 prompt to one short line, such as 「AとBについて、いちばん適切な判断はどれでしょう？」.

niceToHave: practice-b-model / practice-b-model-b: A and B are two separate tables. On mobile the learner scrolls between them to compare (pages/mobile-jp-25.png, pages/mobile-jp-26.png). Consider one 3-column table (確かめること | A | B) with short cells. Both worked tables also sit open right under q9, before the learner answers (pages/desktop-jp-18.png). Consider placing them after the checklist or labelling them as the answer.

s2-settings / practice-model-settings: on mobile, the "command" string on line 9/18 wraps inside the word 'hooks' (pages/mobile-jp-09.png, pages/mobile-jp-23.png). It stays readable and has a copy button. A short note that the value is one line would help learners who type it by hand.

practice-model-intro: on mobile, the chip "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/.claude/hooks/protect-files.sh breaks inside its own box at 'prot|ect-files.sh' (pages/mobile-jp-22.png). It is acceptable, but naming only the file (protect-files.sh) would avoid the break.
reader: on mobile the code-block header truncates the filename to '.claude/hooks/protect-files...' (pages/mobile-jp-22.png). The full name appears only in the paragraph above.
reader: desktop JP charsPerLine median is 42 (max 53) against the 30–40 target, at measurePx 680 and font 18.7 px. This is a reader measure setting, not lesson content.
reader: on mobile the flashcard hint says 「クリックまたはスペースキーでめくる」, which is keyboard and mouse wording on a touch device (pages/mobile-jp-32.png).

reader: the end banner says this is the course's last lesson (drafts are not in course.json). Failed /api/ requests (13) were ignored as environment noise. The full-length mobile PNG stops at 16000 px.
summary: metrics.json has no hard failures. Layout holds up well at 390 px: the TD flowchart, all tables and the soft-wrapped code stay readable, and no screen shows personal data. The one must-fix is the practice-b-quiz prompt: it packs both scenarios A and B into a 10-line bold paragraph, so move them into practice-b-task as a list or table and keep the question short.
